headlines.title: 美国7月成屋销售中位价创历史同期新高
headlines.summary: 美国7月成屋销售降至三个月低点，居高不下的房价和房贷利率继续给房地产市场带来压力。 根据美国全国房地产经纪人协会（NAR）的数据，7月合同成交量环比下降1.7%，折合年率为406万套。 销售中位价同比上涨2%，达到434,100美元，创有记录以来7月份的最高售价，延续了2023年夏季以来的房价年度连涨态势。

headlines.title_en: US existing home sales median price hits record high for the month in July
headlines.summary_en: US existing home sales fell to a three-month low in July, with persistently high home prices and mortgage rates continuing to pressure the housing market. According to the National Association of Realtors (NAR), contract signings decreased 1.7% month-over-month in July to a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 4.06 million units. The median sales price rose 2% year-over-year to $434,100, the highest July price on record, extending the annual price increase trend that began in the summer of 2023.

headlines.title: 巴克莱：美债对价格敏感型买家的依赖显著上升，料使收益率维持高位
headlines.summary: 巴克莱表示，美国国债买家结构正在转向更注重价值的共同基金、家庭和其他私人投资者，这一变化帮助推动30年期美债收益率升至数十年来高位。策略师Demi Hu和Anshul Pradan认为，只要通胀持续存在，这些买家就会要求越来越高的补偿，才愿意持有长期债券。“美国国债的买家基础已经发生变化。”自2022年美联储开始缩减持仓以来，外国央行和美联储等官方部门的需求持续减弱，使得“私人投资者成为吸收新增供应的边际买家”。

headlines.title_en: Barclays: U.S. Treasuries' reliance on price-sensitive buyers rises notably, likely to keep yields elevated
headlines.summary_en: Barclays says the buyer base for US Treasuries is shifting toward value-focused mutual funds, households, and other private investors, a change that has helped drive 30-year Treasury yields to multi-decade highs. Strategists Demi Hu and Anshul Pradan believe that as long as inflation persists, these buyers will demand increasingly higher compensation to hold long-dated bonds. "The buyer base for US Treasuries has changed." Since the Fed began shrinking its holdings in 2022, demand from official sectors such as foreign central banks and the Fed has continued to weaken, making "private investors the marginal buyers absorbing new supply."

headlines.title_en: Germany's two-year government bond yield falls 2 bps
headlines.summary_en: Tuesday (August 11) European afternoon, Germany's 10-year Bund yield fell 2.0 basis points to 3.158%, trading within a 3.208%-3.144% range intraday, "opening higher" at 14:28 Beijing time and holding a high-level narrow range, then declining steadily from 18:00, hitting the day's low at 22:24. The two-year Schatz yield fell 1.2 basis points to 2.789%, trading within a 2.898%-2.774% range, with Bloomberg data showing a brief spike at 14:28 followed by an immediate pullback to around 2.820%; the 30-year Bund yield fell 1.7 basis points to 3.655%. The 2/10-year Bund yield spread fell 0.826 basis points to +36.706 basis points, with abnormal volatility at 14:28—plunging from around +37 basis points to +28.4

headlines.title_en: UK gilt yields broadly fall over 2 bps
headlines.summary_en: Tuesday (August 11) European afternoon, UK 10-year gilt yield fell 2.1 basis points to 4.967%, rising to a day's high of 5.050% at 16:16 Beijing time, then gradually declining, hitting the day's low of 4.939% at 21:49. The two-year gilt yield fell 2.7 basis points to 4.314%, with an intraday range of 4.401%-4.280%. The 30-year gilt yield fell 2 basis points, and the 50-year gilt yield fell 2 basis points. The 2/10-year gilt yield spread rose 0.463 basis points to +64.992 basis points.

headlines.summary: 巴克莱表示，美国国债买家结构正在转向更注重价值的共同基金、家庭和其他私人投资者，这一变化帮助推动30年期美债收益率升至数十年来高位。策略师Demi Hu和Anshul Pradan认为，只要通胀持续存在，这些买家就会要求越来越高的补偿，才愿意持有长期债券。“美国国债的买家基础已经发生变化。”自2022年美联储开始缩减持仓以来，外国央行和美联储等官方部门的需求持续减弱，使得“私人投资者成为吸收新增供应的边际买家”。
